description: MindMap AI lets you create, search, view, edit, style, and export mind maps right inside ChatGPT, and see them rendered in the chat as you work. Create a map from a topic, a brainstorm, or anything you share: PDFs, documents, images, pasted text, or web pages ChatGPT can read. Then keep refining it through chat: expand branches, add relationship arrows to build concept maps, group ideas with summary brackets, and reorganize the structure. Switch between mind map, logic chart, and org chart layouts, apply themes, and export when you're done. Great for brainstorming, studying, planning, and visualizing ideas as a clear outline. Your maps are saved to your MindMap AI account, where you can keep mind mapping on the canvas with full styling control. Works with a free account, and manual editing is always free.
